description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the WorkShiftDao in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations and data retrieval methods related to work shifts, including fetching by ID, listing, saving, editing, deleting, and retrieving employees linked to a specific work shift.

classes.name: WorkShiftDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the WorkShiftDao functions within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of WorkShiftDao, sets up test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a WorkShift object by its ID, verifying its properties.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of WorkShift objects based on a search filter.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests saving a new WorkShift object to the database.

methods.name: testEditWorkShift
methods.description: Tests editing an existing WorkShift and updating it in the database.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple WorkShifts by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Tests retrieving employees associated with a specific WorkShift.
